title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary: Museum provenance merge analysis completed successfully. Merged museum_export_a.csv and museum_export_b.csv into a deduplicated catalog. Key results: 2 raw records merged into 1 unique object (50% deduplication rate). Both batches contained the same artifact (X-100/X100, Han dynasty vase) with complementary provenance notes. Year extraction identified 200 BC date. Deliverables: code/merge_analysis.py, outputs/*.csv, report/report.md with 3 figures (merge_summary.png, temporal_distribution.png, source_contribution.png).
